> **Scope decided 2026-11-19 (G1).** Lightweight SPL Memo transactions on
> Devnet, operator-signed. Full record:
> `docs/solana-integration.md`.

When a round settles, publish the outcome as a **single operator-signed Memo
transaction** so the recorded result is independently timestamped and cannot be
quietly restated later. Points only — no money, no tokens, no NFTs.

Dependencies: `G1` (resolved 2026-11-19), `F18`, `F20` (shared Solana integration module and config).

### Shape

Memo text
`aisd:v1:settle:<roundId>:<winnerModelId>:<pot>:<backerCount>`, written after
`settle_round` has finalized the round. `purpose = 'settlement'` (type `tx_purpose`), `program_id`
null, `idempotency_key` of `settle:<roundId>` so a retried settlement job cannot
publish two different results.

The memo carries **summary facts only** — pot size, winning model, backer count.
Per-user **point credits** stay off-chain in `score_events` / `user_scores`; a
memo is a public one-liner, not a ledger. Nothing here is money (non-negotiable
#1), so avoid the word "payout" in the memo or its copy. Large results (rendered
artifacts, judge output) and private data also stay off-chain. A voided round
records the void rather than a winner.

**No achievement records.** There are no achievements in this product — no tokens,
badges or NFTs — so nothing is recorded for them. If achievements ever exist, they
get their own record type rather than being folded into settlement.

### Acceptance criteria

- A settlement record links to the settled round and to its transaction.
- The memo's summary matches the settled `round_outcomes` row and `competition_results`.
- A failed transaction is retryable, is recorded as `failed`, and is never shown
  to users as confirmed.
- Settling twice does not publish a second, contradictory record.
- No tokens, NFTs, or real-money rewards are introduced.
- Devnet only; a non-devnet cluster is refused.

Source: `REQUIREMENTS.md`, `docs/solana-integration.md`.
